summary: Iteration 6 was a frontend-only re-check at 390x844 as Hank (test-handyman-token). (1) Decline from Jobs: PASS. Jobs > offer > Decline > Confirm shows the toast 'Declined — it's in your Missed list'. The app goes back to Jobs ('/'). The Accept/Decline buttons are gone. missed-job-<id> appears under Missed ('You declined · just now') and the job is no longer under offers. (2) Web accept sheet: PASS. accept-slot-day-0 (tomorrow, Mon 26) is selected and the hour chips show without a tap, with 10 am selected. Summary: 'Visit: Mon, Oct 26, 10:00 AM'. Entering $135 and sending shows the toast 'Sent! Rentwise will confirm the visit'. The status pill then reads 'Waiting on a time'. (3) One edge case still fails. If the ticket is opened directly by URL (web refresh or shared link), there is no screen to go back to. router.back() then fails ('The action GO_BACK was not handled' error toast), and the stale Accept/Decline screen stays. No deprecated Expo packages were seen in the files reviewed.

ui_bugs.issue: router.back() is called with no screen to go back to when the ticket is opened by direct URL, e.g. /ticket/<id> after a web refresh. Expo Router shows the error 'The action GO_BACK was not handled by any navigator'. The screen stays on the stale 'New offer' card with Accept/Decline, even though the decline went through and the success toast showed. Normal navigation from Jobs works.

issues: Day chip labels read '26 Mon' because the en-US output puts the day before the weekday. 'Mon 26' would read more naturally; building the string by hand would fix it.
Chips are 36px tall, below the 44px minimum touch target.
Chips do not set accessibilityState selected, so there is no aria-selected for screen readers or tests.

action_items: In app/ticket/[id].tsx decline onConfirm (and ideally LargeHeader back), use: router.canGoBack() ? router.back() : router.replace('/(handyman)').
Optional: label day chips as 'Mon 26', raise chip height to 44px or more, and pass accessibilityState={{selected}} in Chip.
critical_code_review_comments: useLive still keeps old data when a fetch fails (the root cause from iteration 5). router.back() covers the normal path, but any other 404 after an action (deep link, or a ticket reassigned while viewing) will still show stale buttons. Consider showing an empty or error state when error && data on a 404.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all 3 requested flows pass; the deep-link decline edge case fails)

seed_data_creation: Three test repair tickets were created with make_offer.py: 31f6f075 bathroom sink (declined), 4599f28a toilet (accepted at $135), 60874d48 shower drain (declined via deep link). All were cancelled afterwards; no open tenant tickets remain.
context_for_next_testing_agent: make_offer.py '<plumbing text>' takes about 20s and prints the ticket id. It cancels the tenant's open tickets first. To reproduce the deep-link bug: set localStorage rw_session_token, page.goto('/ticket/<id>') directly, then decline. Server clock is Oct 2026, PDT.
rca_of_issue: After a decline from a direct URL, there is no screen to go back to, so router.back() throws (GO_BACK not handled). The catch shows the error toast. The ticket view stays on the old data because useLive keeps the last snapshot when the follow-up GET returns 404.
